PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
REGISTRATION OF ELECTIONS ACT, No. 44 OF 1980

IN the exercise of the powers vested by Section 8(1) of the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980, the ElectionCommission does hereby appoint for the Electoral Districts specified in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 1967/3 dated 16May 2016 issued by the Election Commission, following Officers mentioned by their designations in the correspondingentry in Column III respectively, in addition to the Assistant Registering Officers appointed for each Electoral District asmentioned in the said Gazette.
MAHINDA DESHAPRIYA,N. J. ABEYSEKERE,S. RATNAJEEVAN H. HOOLE,Chairman,Member,Member,Election CommissionElection CommissionElection Commission
Elections Secretariat,Rajagiriya,06 September 2017.
